files.description: Repository conventions: nine-module topology, driver-interception architecture, the analyzer/Guard/config layering, redaction, suppression, and EXPLAIN safety invariants.

The threat model: redaction-by-default, EXPLAIN-never-executes, and query-semantics-preserving middleware are security invariants, not style preferences — bugs breaking them are in scope as vulnerabilities.
Root package entry points (Register, OpenDB) that wrap middleware.Guard for the database/sql driver layer.
The linter ruleset already enforced in CI, including gosec/errorlint/bodyclose/nilerr — avoid duplicating what golangci-lint already flags.
